criterion_name: Price of HANA-certified compute (scored from the 5-year base-case total cost)
raw_measure: 5-year base-case total cost in EUR (cost engine)
scoring_rule: min-max: score = 1 + 8 x (max - total) / (max - min); cheapest = 9, most expensive = 1
notes: Real: scored from data/prices.csv via the cost engine. Decision Eva 2026-11-20: total base-case cost instead of EUR per GB RAM-hour

criterion_name: Certified scale-up range (largest certified single-node memory)
raw_measure: largest memory (TiB) of a VM or bare-metal system in the SAP HANA hardware directory listed as OLTP single node
where_to_look: SAP Certified and Supported SAP HANA Hardware Directory, IaaS Platforms, filter by provider and Application Type OLTP single node; sort by memory

criterion_name: Availability (published VM SLA for a multi-zone setup)
raw_measure: monthly uptime % in the provider's VM SLA for instances spread over two or more zones in one region
scoring_rule: score = 1 + 8 x (100 - best SLA) / (100 - SLA); compares allowed downtime (best = 9)
where_to_look: AWS: Amazon Compute Service Level Agreement; Azure: SLA for Online Services (Virtual Machines); Google Cloud: Compute Engine SLA

checklist_items: (a) the provider's own backup service or agent is SAP-certified for SAP HANA Backint; (b) with the provider's own tooling HANA backups can be copied to or restored in another region
where_to_look: AWS: AWS Backint Agent / AWS Backup for SAP HANA docs; Azure: Azure Backup for SAP HANA docs; Google Cloud: Backint feature of Google Cloud's Agent for SAP / Backup and DR docs; SAP Note 2031547 (Backint certifications)
notes: Items as agreed in Chat 2 (2026-11-01). An item counts only if a public source shows it; otherwise 'not found' = 0

criterion_name: EU data residency (EU regions with HANA-certified instances)
raw_measure: number of provider regions located in EU member states where at least one SAP HANA-certified instance type is offered
where_to_look: AWS: SAP on AWS docs, 'SAP HANA certified instances' region list; Azure: 'Products available by region' for M-series / SAP HANA certified VM docs; Google Cloud: 'Certifications for SAP HANA on Google Cloud' (regions per machine type)
notes: EU = EU member states only (UK, Switzerland and Norway not counted). Rule proposed 2026-11-26; needs Eva's OK

checklist_items: (a) ISO/IEC 27001; (b) SOC 2 Type II; (c) BSI C5; (d) a generally available EU data boundary commitment (customer data stored and processed in the EU)
where_to_look: AWS: AWS Compliance Programs page and AWS Artifact; Azure: Microsoft compliance offerings (Service Trust Portal) and EU Data Boundary docs; Google Cloud: Compliance resource center and Assured Workloads / sovereign cloud docs
notes: Items as agreed in Chat 2 (2026-11-01). An item counts only if a public source shows it; otherwise 'not found' = 0
